component.name: Control Center
component.summary: All the settings of SDE in one place

description.p: The Control Center gathers every setting of the Selviana Desktop Environment on one overview, by category: Personalization (appearance, desktop, panel, Start menu, clock, notifications), System (display, sound, power, date and time, users and avatar, default and startup applications, keyboard, mouse and touchpad), Network and Internet, Devices, Administration and About, with a search over all of them.
Users and Avatar changes the account picture, from the stock pictures or a picture of your own, and the real name; the Start menu, the lock screen and the login screen show them.
Display profile model based on DisplayProfileManager by zac15987 (MIT).
Part of the Selviana Desktop Environment, developed by the Selviana DE Project.
